key_idea: Walk i from 1 to n matching the decimal form of i at the current position; the first i that does not match is the erased one.
sketch: Keep a pointer into the digit string; for each i compare to_string(i) against the string at the pointer and advance on a match. The first mismatch (including running off the end, which handles the erased number being n) is the answer. This is unambiguous because the next number actually present is i+1, whose decimal form never starts with that of i (9 to 10 and 99 to 100 included). O(length).
